/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

// Exports the contents of a grid (using the selected order and filters) to a PDF file.
&IsAuthorized = SecGAMIsAuthByFunctionalityKey.Udp(!'auditww_Execute') 
If &IsAuthorized

	LoadWWPContext.Call(&WWPContext)

Do 'LoadGridState'

&Title = "Audit List"

//Report Template Source
	Header
		&AppName = "DVelop Software Solutions"
		&Phone = !"+1 550 8923"
		&Mail = !"info@mail.com"
		&Website = !"http://www.web.com"
		&AddressLine1 = !"French Boulevard 2859"
		&AddressLine2 = !"Downtown"
		&AddressLine3 = !"Paris, France"
		Print printTitle
	End 
	Footer
		&PageInfo = "Page: " + &Page.ToString().Trim()
		&DateInfo = "Date: " + &Today.ToFormattedString()
		Print printFooter
	End

	Do 'PrintFilters'

	Do 'PrintColumnTitles'

	Do 'PrintData'

	Do 'PrintFooter'

EndIf

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */


Sub 'PrintFilters'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	If not &FilterFullText.IsEmpty()
		print printBlockFilterFilterFullText
	EndIf
	If not (&TFAuditId.IsEmpty() AND &TFAuditId_To.IsEmpty())
		print printBlockTFAuditId
		&TFAuditId_To_Description = format('%1 (%2)', "Id", "WWP_TSTo")
		print printBlockTFAuditId_To
	EndIf
	If not (&TFAuditDate.IsEmpty() AND &TFAuditDate_To.IsEmpty())
		print printBlockTFAuditDate
		&TFAuditDate_To_Description = format('%1 (%2)', "Date", "WWP_TSTo")
		print printBlockTFAuditDate_To
	EndIf
	If not &TFAuditTableName_Sel.IsEmpty()
		print printBlockTFAuditTableName_Sel
	Else
		If not &TFAuditTableName.IsEmpty()
			print printBlockTFAuditTableName
		EndIf
	EndIf
	If not (&TFAuditTableKey.IsEmpty() AND &TFAuditTableKey_To.IsEmpty())
		print printBlockTFAuditTableKey
		&TFAuditTableKey_To_Description = format('%1 (%2)', "Table Key", "WWP_TSTo")
		print printBlockTFAuditTableKey_To
	EndIf
	If not &TFAuditDescription_Sel.IsEmpty()
		print printBlockTFAuditDescription_Sel
	Else
		If not &TFAuditDescription.IsEmpty()
			print printBlockTFAuditDescription
		EndIf
	EndIf
	If not &TFAuditShortDescription_Sel.IsEmpty()
		print printBlockTFAuditShortDescription_Sel
	Else
		If not &TFAuditShortDescription.IsEmpty()
			print printBlockTFAuditShortDescription
		EndIf
	EndIf
	If not &TFGAMUserGUID_Sel.IsEmpty()
		print printBlockTFGAMUserGUID_Sel
	Else
		If not &TFGAMUserGUID.IsEmpty()
			print printBlockTFGAMUserGUID
		EndIf
	EndIf
	If not (&TFSecUserId.IsEmpty() AND &TFSecUserId_To.IsEmpty())
		print printBlockTFSecUserId
		&TFSecUserId_To_Description = format('%1 (%2)', "User Id", "WWP_TSTo")
		print printBlockTFSecUserId_To
	EndIf
	If not &TFAuditAction_Sel.IsEmpty()
		print printBlockTFAuditAction_Sel
	Else
		If not &TFAuditAction.IsEmpty()
			print printBlockTFAuditAction
		EndIf
	EndIf

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

Sub 'PrintColumnTitles'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	print printBlockBeforeGrid
	print printBlockLines_titles

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

Sub 'PrintData'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	For each Audit
		order AuditDate  when &OrderedBy = 1 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (AuditDate)  when &OrderedBy = 1 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order AuditId  when &OrderedBy = 2 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (AuditId)  when &OrderedBy = 2 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order AuditTableName  when &OrderedBy = 3 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (AuditTableName)  when &OrderedBy = 3 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order AuditTableKey  when &OrderedBy = 4 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (AuditTableKey)  when &OrderedBy = 4 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order AuditDescription  when &OrderedBy = 5 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (AuditDescription)  when &OrderedBy = 5 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order AuditShortDescription  when &OrderedBy = 6 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (AuditShortDescription)  when &OrderedBy = 6 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order GAMUserGUID  when &OrderedBy = 7 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (GAMUserGUID)  when &OrderedBy = 7 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order SecUserId  when &OrderedBy = 8 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (SecUserId)  when &OrderedBy = 8 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order AuditAction  when &OrderedBy = 9 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (AuditAction)  when &OrderedBy = 9 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		
		using AuditWWDS(&FilterFullText, &TFAuditId, &TFAuditId_To, &TFAuditDate, &TFAuditDate_To, &TFAuditTableName
					, &TFAuditTableName_Sel, &TFAuditTableKey, &TFAuditTableKey_To, &TFAuditDescription, &TFAuditDescription_Sel, &TFAuditShortDescription
					, &TFAuditShortDescription_Sel, &TFGAMUserGUID, &TFGAMUserGUID_Sel, &TFSecUserId, &TFSecUserId_To, &TFAuditAction
					, &TFAuditAction_Sel)

		Do 'BeforePrintLine'
		print printBlockLines_data
		Do 'AfterPrintLine'
	EndFor

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

Sub 'LoadGridState'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	// Load grid state from session.
	If &Session.Get(!"WWPBaseObjects.AuditWWGridState") = !""
		&GridState.FromXml(LoadGridState.Udp(!"WWPBaseObjects.AuditWWGridState"))
	Else
		&GridState.FromXml(&Session.Get(!"WWPBaseObjects.AuditWWGridState"))
	Endif	

	&OrderedBy = &GridState.OrderedBy
	&OrderedDsc = &GridState.OrderedDsc

	For &GridStateFilterValue in &GridState.FilterValues
		Do Case
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"FILTERFULLTEXT"
				&FilterFullText.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFAUDITID"
				&TFAuditId.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
				&TFAuditId_To.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.ValueTo)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFAUDITDATE"
				&TFAuditDate.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
				&TFAuditDate_To.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.ValueTo)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFAUDITTABLENAME"
				&TFAuditTableName.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFAUDITTABLENAME_SEL"
				&TFAuditTableName_Sel.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFAUDITTABLEKEY"
				&TFAuditTableKey.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
				&TFAuditTableKey_To.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.ValueTo)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFAUDITDESCRIPTION"
				&TFAuditDescription.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFAUDITDESCRIPTION_SEL"
				&TFAuditDescription_Sel.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFAUDITSHORTDESCRIPTION"
				&TFAuditShortDescription.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFAUDITSHORTDESCRIPTION_SEL"
				&TFAuditShortDescription_Sel.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFGAMUSERGUID"
				&TFGAMUserGUID.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFGAMUSERGUID_SEL"
				&TFGAMUserGUID_Sel.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFSECUSERID"
				&TFSecUserId.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
				&TFSecUserId_To.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.ValueTo)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFAUDITACTION"
				&TFAuditAction.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFAUDITACTION_SEL"
				&TFAuditAction_Sel.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
		EndCase
	EndFor

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */



	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */



	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub
